[ISBK.3.1] The built-in ring-buffer backend is the reference implementation of
the vtable; it lives in `runtime/src/libds/series/ring_buffer.c` +
`runtime/src/libds/series/ring_buffer_backend.c` and is compiled into `libds.a`,
registered with the other six when libds constructs an engine ([NSBK.2]). Its
name and version, and the other six's, are [NDET.2.5]'s.

It is the reference in the sense that every other backend's vtable is shaped
like it — not in the sense that an integrator may supply a competing one
([NSBK.2.3]).
